claims.claim: BlindSpotEval evaluates LLM-generated unit tests by three obligation metrics (Boundary-Value Adequacy, Control-Flow Adequacy, Oracle Strength) plus execution reliability, on ObligBench with 895 complex and 700 low-complexity Java functions.
claims.stance_target: self-written test adequacy beyond coverage and mutation
claims.scope_conditions: Java, four LLMs, four prompting strategies
claims.quoted_support: a complexity-stratified Java benchmark comprising 895 complex and 700 low-complexity functions with source-side obligation annotations.

claims.claim: Four LLMs evaluated: GPT-5.4, Gemma-4-31B, Gemini-3.6-flash, Qwen3-Coder-30B.
claims.quoted_support: we evaluate four LLMs (GPT-5.4, Gemma-4-31B, Gemini-3.6-flash, and Qwen3-Coder-30B)

claims.claim: Aggregate coverage and mutation scores do not distinguish systematic adequacy blind spots, especially inputs needing semantic reasoning about the function's contract.
claims.quoted_support: Our results reveal systematic adequacy blind spots that aggregate coverage and mutation scores do not distinguish.

breadth.confidence_families: not present (searched: confidence, calibration, verbal, logit; paper evaluates test adequacy, not confidence)
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: GPT-5.4, Gemma-4-31B, Gemini-3.6-flash, Qwen3-Coder-30B (Section Experimental Setup).
breadth.elicitation_formats: Four prompting strategies including zero-shot and intention-based (main experiment).
breadth.benchmarks: ObligBench (Java, 1,595 functions); comparisons mention TestGenEval, EvalPlus, SWE-bench.
breadth.label_source: Source-side obligation annotations and execution/JUnit results.
breadth.label_independence: Complexity-stratified control set of 700 low-complexity functions; manual stratified sample of 780 BVA instances for validation.
breadth.contamination_split: not present (searched: training-data contamination analysis; related work notes contamination-mitigating benchmarks)
breadth.granularity: Per-obligation (boundary values, control flow, oracle strength) per function; finer than coverage/mutation aggregates.
breadth.causal_intervention: Prompting-strategy and complexity-control comparisons; no model-internal intervention.
